response.sql:
WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT record_count
  FROM counts_by_type
  WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts_by_type)
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts_by_type)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct non-NULL ordertune is a type; SQL grouping places orders with NULL ordertune in a single type group, which is included in the across-type average.
